```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(dplyr)
library(plotly)
library(scales)
library(glue)
library(DT)
```

# Pendahuluan

Laporan ini menyajikan hasil Komparasi Skenario antara Skenario Business As Usual (BAU) dan Skenario Intervensi. Analisis ini menghitung Keuntungan Usaha Tani berdasarkan data luas proyeksi, persentase penerapan, dan nilai EAE per tahun yang disediakan dalam file Excel.

# Data Input

## Pratinjau Data Excel {.tabset}

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(params$scenario_file_path) && file.exists(params$scenario_file_path)) {
  
  sheet_names <- readxl::excel_sheets(params$scenario_file_path)
  
  env <- new.env()
  env$file_path <- params$scenario_file_path
  
  for (sheet_name in sheet_names) {
    
    sheet_name_clean <- trimws(sheet_name)
    if (tolower(sheet_name_clean) == "readme") next
    
    child_content <- c(
      paste0("### ", sheet_name_clean),
      "",
      "```{r}",
      "#| echo: false",
      paste0("df_sheet <- readxl::read_excel(file_path, sheet = '", sheet_name_clean, "')"),
      "if (nrow(df_sheet) > 0 && ncol(df_sheet) > 0) {",
      
      # Cek apakah ini sheet Persentase/Penerapan
      "  is_pct <- grepl('Persentase|Penerapan', '", sheet_name_clean, "', ignore.case = TRUE)",
      
      # Jika persentase, kalikan kolom ke-3 dst dengan 100
      "  if (is_pct) {",
      "    df_sheet <- df_sheet %>%",
      "      mutate(across(3:ncol(df_sheet), ~ .x * 100))",
      "  }",
      
      # Buat Datatable Dasar
      "  dt <- DT::datatable(",
      "    df_sheet,",
      "    rownames = FALSE,",
      "    extensions = c('Buttons', 'Scroller'),",
      "    options = list(",
      "      paging = FALSE,",
      "      scrollY = '300px',",
      "      scrollX = TRUE,",
      "      searching = TRUE,",
      "      responsive = FALSE,",
      "      dom = 'Blfrtip',",
      "      buttons = list(",
      "        list(extend = 'copy', className = 'btn btn-light btn-sm'),",
      "        list(extend = 'csv',  className = 'btn btn-light btn-sm'),",
      "        list(extend = 'excel',className = 'btn btn-light btn-sm')",
      "      )",
      "    )",
      "  )",
      
      # Format semua kolom numerik (kolom ke-3 dst) dengan scales::comma
      "  # Format ribuan + 2 desimal",
      "  for (col_idx in 3:ncol(df_sheet)) {",
      "    if (is.numeric(df_sheet[[col_idx]])) {",
      "      if (is_pct) {",
      "        dt <- dt %>% DT::formatString(",
      "          columns = col_idx,",
      "          prefix = '',",
      "          suffix = ' %'",
      "        ) %>% DT::formatRound(columns = col_idx, digits = 2)",
      "      } else {",
      "        dt <- dt %>% DT::formatString(",
      "          columns = col_idx,",
      "          prefix = '',",
      "          suffix = ''",
      "        ) %>% DT::formatRound(columns = col_idx, digits = 2) %>%",
      "          DT::formatCurrency(columns = col_idx, currency = '', interval = 3, mark = ',', digits = 2)",
      "      }",
      "    }",
      "  }",
      
      "  dt",
      "} else {",
      "  cat('*Sheet ini kosong.*')",
      "}",
      "```"
    )
    
    res <- knitr::knit_child(text = child_content, envir = env, quiet = TRUE)
    cat(res, sep = "\n")
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

# Perbandingan Skenario BAU dan Intervensi {.tabset}

## Grafik Garis per Tahun

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Grafik menggunakan data agregat per tahun (yearly_summary)
plot_ly(params$yearly_summary, x = ~Tahun) %>%
  add_trace(y = ~`Total Keuntungan BAU`, name = 'Skenario BAU', 
            type = 'scatter', mode = 'lines+markers', 
            line = list(color = 'blue')) %>%
  add_trace(y = ~`Total Keuntungan Intervensi`, name = 'Skenario Intervensi', 
            type = 'scatter', mode = 'lines+markers', 
            line = list(color = 'green')) %>%
  layout(
    title = "Perbandingan Total Keuntungan Usaha Tani (BAU vs Intervensi) per Tahun",
    xaxis = list(title = "Tahun"),
    yaxis = list(title = paste("Total Keuntungan Usaha Tani (", params$currency, ")", sep = "")),
    hovermode = "x unified"
  )
```

## Tabel Komparasi per Tahun

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
params$yearly_summary %>%
  # Hitung Persentase Selisih
  mutate(
    `Persentase Selisih (%)` = ifelse(
      `Total Keuntungan BAU` > 0, 
      (`Total Selisih` / `Total Keuntungan BAU`) * 100, 
      0
    )
  ) %>%
  # Format angka
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = c(`Total Luas BAU (Ha)`, `Total Luas Intervensi (Ha)`, 
                `Total Keuntungan BAU`, `Total Keuntungan Intervensi`, `Total Selisih`),
      .fns = ~scales::comma(.x)
    ),
    `Persentase Selisih (%)` = paste0(round(`Persentase Selisih (%)`, 2), "%")
  ) %>%
  # Rename kolom dengan tambahan mata uang
  rename(
    `Tahun` = Tahun,
    `Total Luas BAU (Ha)` = `Total Luas BAU (Ha)`,
    `Total Luas Intervensi (Ha)` = `Total Luas Intervensi (Ha)`,
    !!glue::glue("Total Keuntungan BAU ({params$currency})") := `Total Keuntungan BAU`,
    !!glue::glue("Total Keuntungan Intervensi ({params$currency})") := `Total Keuntungan Intervensi`,
    !!glue::glue("Total Selisih ({params$currency})") := `Total Selisih`,
    `Persentase Selisih (%)` = `Persentase Selisih (%)`
  ) %>%
  DT::datatable(
    rownames = FALSE,
    extensions = c('Buttons'), 
    options = list(
      paging = TRUE,
      searching = TRUE,
      responsive = FALSE,
      dom = 'Blfrtip',
      buttons = list(
        list(extend = "copy", className = "btn btn-light btn-sm"),
        list(extend = "csv",  className = "btn btn-light btn-sm"),
        list(extend = "excel",className = "btn btn-light btn-sm")
      )
    )
  )
```

## Tabel Detail Per Kelas Tutupan Lahan

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
params$projection_table %>%
  # 1. Format kolom Persentase (Gunakan nama kolom yang sudah di-rename)
  mutate(
    `Persentase BAU` = paste0(round(`Persentase BAU` * 100, 2), "%"),
    `Persentase Intervensi` = paste0(round(`Persentase Intervensi` * 100, 2), "%"),
    `Persentase Selisih (%)` = paste0(round(`Persentase Selisih (%)`, 2), "%")
  ) %>%
  # 2. Format angka ribuan untuk kolom numerik
  mutate(
    across(
      .cols = c(
        `Luas BAU (Ha)`, 
        `Luas Intervensi (Ha)`, 
        `EAE BAU`, 
        `EAE Intervensi`, 
        `Keuntungan BAU`, 
        `Keuntungan Intervensi`, 
        `Selisih`
      ),
      .fns = ~scales::comma(.x)
    )
  ) %>%
  # 3. Rename kolom dan tambahkan satuan mata uang
  rename(
    `ID` = ID,
    `Tutupan Lahan` = `Tutupan Lahan`,
    `Tahun` = Tahun,
    `Luas BAU (Ha)` = `Luas BAU (Ha)`,
    `Luas Intervensi (Ha)` = `Luas Intervensi (Ha)`,
    !!glue::glue("EAE BAU ({params$currency})") := `EAE BAU`,
    !!glue::glue("EAE Intervensi ({params$currency})") := `EAE Intervensi`,
    `Persentase BAU` = `Persentase BAU`,
    `Persentase Intervensi` = `Persentase Intervensi`,
    !!glue::glue("Keuntungan BAU ({params$currency})") := `Keuntungan BAU`,
    !!glue::glue("Keuntungan Intervensi ({params$currency})") := `Keuntungan Intervensi`,
    !!glue::glue("Selisih ({params$currency})") := `Selisih`,
    `Persentase Selisih` = `Persentase Selisih (%)`
  ) %>%
  # 4. Tampilkan DataTable
  DT::datatable(
    rownames = FALSE,
    # HAPUS 'Responsive' DARI EXTENSIONS
    extensions = c('Buttons', 'Scroller'), 
    options = list(
      paging = FALSE,
      scrollY = "400px",
      scrollX = TRUE,
      searching = TRUE,
      fixedColumns = FALSE,
      responsive = FALSE,  # MATIKAN FITUR RESPONSIVE
      dom = 'Blfrtip',
      buttons = list(
        list(extend = "copy", className = "btn btn-light btn-sm"),
        list(extend = "csv",  className = "btn btn-light btn-sm"),
        list(extend = "excel",className = "btn btn-light btn-sm")
      )
    )
  )
```

## Perbandingan Skenario BAU dan Intervensi per Unit Perencanaan

Tabel berikut menampilkan perbandingan keuntungan antara Skenario BAU dan Intervensi untuk masing-masing Unit Perencanaan (PU).

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
if (!is.null(params$pu_summary) && nrow(params$pu_summary) > 0) {
  params$pu_summary %>%
    # 1. Hitung Persentase Selisih
    mutate(
      `Persentase Selisih (%)` = ifelse(
        `Keuntungan BAU per PU` > 0,
        (`Selisih per PU` / `Keuntungan BAU per PU`) * 100,
        0
      )
    ) %>%
    # 2. Format angka & persentase
    mutate(
      across(
        .cols = c(Area_Ha, `Keuntungan BAU per PU`, `Keuntungan Intervensi per PU`, `Selisih per PU`),
        .fns = ~scales::comma(.x)
      ),
      `Persentase Selisih (%)` = paste0(round(`Persentase Selisih (%)`, 2), "%")
    ) %>%
    # 3. Pilih & Rename kolom dengan satuan mata uang
    dplyr::select(
      `PU ID` = PU_ID,
      `Unit Perencanaan` = PU_Name,
      `Luas (Ha)` = Area_Ha,
      `Tahun` = Tahun,
      !!glue::glue("Keuntungan BAU ({params$currency})") := `Keuntungan BAU per PU`,
      !!glue::glue("Keuntungan Intervensi ({params$currency})") := `Keuntungan Intervensi per PU`,
      !!glue::glue("Selisih ({params$currency})") := `Selisih per PU`,
      `Persentase Selisih` = `Persentase Selisih (%)`
    ) %>%
    # 4. Tampilkan DataTable
    DT::datatable(
      rownames = FALSE,
      extensions = c('Buttons', 'Scroller'),
      options = list(
        paging = FALSE,
        scrollY = "400px",
        scrollX = TRUE,
        searching = TRUE,
        responsive = FALSE,
        dom = 'Blfrtip',
        buttons = list(
          list(extend = "copy", className = "btn btn-light btn-sm"),
          list(extend = "csv",  className = "btn btn-light btn-sm"),
          list(extend = "excel",className = "btn btn-light btn-sm")
        )
      )
    )
} else {
  cat("Data per Unit Perencanaan (PU) tidak tersedia.")
}
```

# Kesimpulan

Total keuntungan Skenario BAU adalah `r params$currency` `r scales::label_comma()(params$total_keuntungan_bau)`, sedangkan total keuntungan Skenario Intervensi adalah `r params$currency` `r scales::label_comma()(params$total_keuntungan_intervensi)`.

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, results='asis'}
selisih <- params$total_selisih
pct <- params$total_persentase_selisih

if (selisih > 0) {
  cat(glue::glue("\n\nSkenario Intervensi memberikan keuntungan **lebih tinggi sebesar {params$currency}  {scales::label_comma()(selisih)} ({round(pct, 2)}%)** dibandingkan Skenario BAU.\n"))
} else if (selisih < 0) {
  cat(glue::glue("\n\nSkenario Intervensi memberikan keuntungan **lebih rendah sebesar {params$currency} {scales::label_comma()(abs(selisih))} ({round(abs(pct), 2)}%)** dibandingkan Skenario BAU.\n"))
} else {
  cat("\n\nSkenario Intervensi dan Skenario BAU menghasilkan **total keuntungan yang sama**.\n")
}
```
